assets.purpose: Silent opening establishing shot that gives the unknown ledger voice and Qinhuai night room before the ledger reveal

prompt.positive: Use Image 1 as the exact 16:9 Qinhuai waterside location, cold moonlit exposure, distant timber architecture, sparse warm windows and open foreground water. Create one restrained eight-second live-action period-drama establishing shot from a locked low camera just above the water. Begin near black and reveal the location through natural mist and reflected moonlight, with only physically plausible small water ripples, slow mist drift and distant window reflections. Keep the lower central water empty and readable because the following shot introduces the ledger there. End on the same broad empty-water composition and lighting identity as Image 1 so the next ledger-reveal shot can cut cleanly. No book, paper, people, boat, lantern spectacle, camera cut or fantasy effect. Silent clean picture plate only.
negative: ledger, book, paper, hand, person, face, boat, modern object or skyline
readable text, calligraphy, subtitles, captions, logo, watermark or pseudo-writing
magic particles, portal, glowing runes, purple fantasy light, gold spectacle or explosive water
camera cut, fast pan, zoom, orbit, drone move, time lapse, focus pumping or violent shake
vertical framing, portrait composition, black crush, overexposed moon or dense foreground obstruction
generated dialogue, speech, music, sound effects or any embedded audio
prompt.script: 0.0–1.5s near-black water and distant room tone image; 1.5–5.5s moonlit Qinhuai architecture and mist become readable through a restrained exposure lift; 5.5–8.0s settle on broad empty foreground water with the lower centre clear for the next ledger reveal.

references.role: Reviewed 16:9 Qinhuai water, architecture, moon position and cold-night exposure reference

acceptance: The shot remains a cinematic 1920x1080 landscape establishing take with no camera cut
The empty foreground water, moon position, architecture and exposure connect cleanly to the ledger reveal
The 192-frame master contains no ledger, people, pseudo-text, watermark or audio stream
rejection: Reject decorative tourism lighting, fantasy particles, moving camera spectacle or a book appearing early
Reject crushed detail, modern objects, pseudo-writing, vertical framing or any embedded audio

assets.purpose: Silent match transition from the confirmed blank ledger to the sealed recommendation letter at the start of SC01

prompt.positive: Image 1 is the exact final frame after the player profile has been confirmed: an open side-sewn Chinese blank ledger floating on moonlit Qinhuai water with a diffuse pale-red fibre mark on the right page. Image 2 is the exact first frame of the following carriage scene: a closed recommendation letter packet on dark carriage wood. Create one restrained twelve-second cinematic match transition between these controlled frames. Hold Image 1 composition for the first second, then move slowly toward the pale-red paper fibres until the page texture and dark water reflection fill the frame. Use a physically plausible match dissolve through paper fibre, reflected darkness and carriage vibration—not a magical morph. Resolve gradually into the sealed recommendation letter on the dark wooden carriage surface and arrive on Image 2 composition for the final two seconds. Preserve the red pigment as a visual match, keep all objects historically plausible, and never show the player in third person. One continuous editorial transition, silent clean picture plate, no dialogue or text generation.
negative: readable generated text, calligraphy, subtitles, captions, logo, watermark or pseudo-writing
magic portal, particles, glowing runes, fire, lightning, gold fantasy light or teleportation
western codex, deformed book, melting object, extra paper, hand, person, face or modern object
hard black cut, random location, rapid zoom, orbit, violent shake, focus pumping or time lapse
vertical framing, portrait crop, discontinuous moonlight, changing seal geometry or duplicated objects
generated dialogue, speech, music, sound effects or any embedded audio
prompt.script: 0.0–1.0s exact Image 1 hold; 1.0–4.5s restrained push toward the pale-red right-page fibres and adjacent dark reflection; 4.5–8.5s paper fibre and darkness form a controlled match dissolve with subtle carriage vibration entering; 8.5–10.0s the sealed letter and dark wood become fully readable; 10.0–12.0s arrive exactly on Image 2 composition and hold for the SC01 cut.

references.role: Ordered Image 1: exact frame 143 of the reviewed P00 confirm picture master
Ordered Image 2: exact frame 0 of the reviewed SC01 carriage main picture master

acceptance: The shot begins on the exact confirmed-ledger frame and ends on the exact SC01 carriage frame
The match transition reads as controlled editorial paper-and-reflection continuity rather than fantasy transformation
The 288-frame 1920x1080 master contains no black cut, pseudo-text, watermark or audio stream

Reject failure to reach the SC01 first-frame composition, vertical framing or any embedded audio
